Definition: Baladan, the name of a Babylonian prince
BiblicalUsage: Baladan is named only as the father of Berodach-baladan, the king of Babylon. He sent letters and a present to Hezekiah when he heard the king had been sick.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name can matter simply because of the son it belongs to, and this one opens the door to Isaiah's hard word about Babylon carrying everything away.
RelatedPeople: Baladan, Father of Berodach-Baladan; Berodach-Baladan, King of Babylon
